title: 掌紋接上了
subject: a young woman who reads palms at a night-market folding table, a trade her grandfather taught her, and the man who sits down, asks no question about money or exams, and whose palm lines meet hers exactly when they touch
caption: Mandarin Brazilian choro, nimble Rio roda-de-choro in lively 2/4 with a Chinese night-market setting. Cavaquinho playing bright rhythmic chord strums, 7-string guitar walking baixaria bass runs between the phrases, silver flute carrying the melody with quick turns, pandeiro with crisp jingle and thumb strokes. Warm intimate roda-de-choro live mix with natural room air. Female lead, warm low-mid chest voice, relaxed and clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, A minor. warm, teasing, nimble mood. No rap, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no synth pads, no electronic drums, no heavy backbeat.
lyrics:
[Intro - flute, cavaquinho, 7-string guitar, pandeiro]

[Verse 1]
夜市最角落 一張小摺桌
我替人看手相 一次一百
生命線太短 我說會變長
感情線打結 我說放輕鬆

[Pre-Chorus]
今晚有個男生 坐下沒開口
伸出左手 掌心有點汗

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
看了這麼多年 別人的線
第一次 看見我自己

[Verse 2]
他說不問財運 也不問考試
只想問一件事 能不能牽手
我把手放上去 兩條線碰頭
爺爺教的口訣 全忘光了

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
看了這麼多年 別人的線
這一次 輪到你看我

[Bridge - 7-string guitar and pandeiro alone]
爺爺說 看相的人
不可以替自己算
那你替我算 我替你算

[Chorus]
你的掌紋 對我的掌紋
一條接過來 剛好接上
收攤吧 明天還在這裡
我們一起 看別人的線

[Outro - flute and cavaquinho fade]
今天的手相 不收錢
